chunks: On this day, after the assembly, the illustrious Shaykh Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Musa ibn Babawayh al-Qummi (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Ali Majilawayh (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: My uncle Muhammad ibn Abi al-Qasim narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Ali al-Kufi, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from al-Mufaddal ibn Umar, from Jabir ibn Yazid, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Samara. He said:

I said: O Messenger of God, guide me to salvation. So he said: O Ibn Samara, when whims differ and opinions diverge, then hold fast to Ali ibn Abi Talib, for he is the Imam of my nation and my vicegerent over them after me. He is the Criterion (al-Faruq) who distinguishes between truth and falsehood. Whoever asks him, he will answer him. Whoever seeks direction from him, he will guide him. Whoever seeks truth from him will find it. Whoever seeks guidance from him will encounter it. Whoever seeks refuge in him will be safe. Whoever holds onto him will be saved. Whoever emulates him will be guided.

O Ibn Samara, those who make peace with him and align with him will be at peace, and those who renege from him and oppose him will perish. O Ibn Samara, indeed Ali is from me, his spirit is from my spirit, and his clay is from my clay. He is my brother and I am his brother. He is the husband of my daughter Fatima, the Mistress of the Women of the Worlds from the former and the latter peoples. Indeed, from him are the two Imams of my nation and the two Masters of the Youth of Paradise, al-Hasan and al-Husayn, and nine from the descendants of al-Husayn. Their ninth is the Qa'im of my nation, who will fill the earth with justice and equity as it was filled with injustice and oppression.

key_terms.الفاروق: Al-Faruq: The Criterion, one who distinguishes between truth and falsehood, a title applied here to Imam Ali
key_terms.خليفتي: My vicegerent/successor: denotes designated political and spiritual authority after the Prophet
key_terms.سيدة نساء العالمين: Mistress of the Women of the Worlds: the supreme title of Lady Fatima al-Zahra
key_terms.قائم أمتي: The Qa'im of my nation: the awaited Imam al-Mahdi who will rise to establish justice

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about Ali ibn Abi Talib being the path to salvation?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) instructed Abd al-Rahman ibn Samara to follow Ali ibn Abi Talib (AS) as the path to salvation, especially when communities become divided. He declared Ali's comprehensive authority as Imam, vicegerent, and the criterion between truth and falsehood. He then affirmed Ali's unique spiritual bond with himself, described Fatima (SA) as Mistress of the Women of all creation, and prophesied the twelve Imams culminating in the Mahdi who will fill the earth with justice. This hadith, narrated in al-Amali of Shaykh al-Saduq during a Friday assembly in 367 AH, is a key text in Shia theology for establishing the doctrine of the Imamate.

en.bilal-muhammad: On this day, after the majlis, Abu Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babuwayh al-Qummi (rh) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. `Ali Majiluwayh (rh) narrated to us. He said: My uncle Muhammad b. Abi’l Qasim narrated to us from Muhammad b. `Ali al-Kufi from Muhammad b. Sinan from al-Mufaddal b. `Umar from Jabir b. Yazid from Sa`id b. al-Musayyib from `Abd al-Rahman b. Samara. He said:

I said: O Messenger of Allah! Guide me to salvation. So, he said: O Ibn Samara! When the whims differ and when sights diverge, take to `Ali b. Abi Talib, for he is the Imam of my Nation and my vicegerent over them after me. He is the criterion who will distinguish between truth and falsehood. Whoever asks him [a question], he will answer him. Whoever seeks direction from him will be directed by him. Whoever demands a right from him will find it. Whoever seeks guidance from him will encounter it. Whoever seeks refuge in him will be safe. Whoever holds onto him will be saved. Whoever emulates him will be guided.

O Ibn Samara! Those who make peace with him and align with him will be at peace; and those who renege from him and oppose him will perish. O Ibn Samara! `Ali is from me, his spirit is from my spirit, and his clay is from my clay. He is my brother, and I am his brother. He is the husband of my daughter Fatima, the Mistress of the Women of the Worlds from the former and the latter peoples. From him are two Imams from my Nation and the two Masters of the Youth of Paradise, al-Hasan and al-Husayn; and nine from the descendants of al-Husayn. Their ninth is the Qa’im from my Nation, who will fill Earth with justice and peace as it will be fraught with injustice and oppression.
